description.en: Turns a character to face a point over a number of frames: the direction is worked out with GetRyLookAtPos, then CMND_CHR_TURN_TRG(_hdl, 0, direction, _frame, 1) turns the character with the walk motion. Wait for the end with WaitEvLowMdlMoving.
Duration of the turn in frames.

examples.case: Turning toward where the character will walk (real usage, from ev42010200.nut)
